characters.summary: Cotterpin Doozer is an engineer and builder from Fraggle Rock who works with microscopic industry, constructing structures out of radish sticks and architectural materials. She relies on engineering expertise, specialized Doozer construction tools, and hard hats rather than direct combat prowess.

mechanisms: Small stature making her difficult to target

weaknesses: Extremely small physical size compared to standard humanoids or Fraggles
limitations: Extremely tiny stature limits physical reach and combat impact
Compelled by nature to constantly build

sources.supports: Basic summary of Doozers and their engineering role in Fraggle Rock.

feats.claim: Constructed complex structures out of edible radish-based materials under tight deadlines.

unknowns: Exact combat utility against full-sized opponents is not established.

characters.summary: Crazy Harry is an unhinged pyrotechnician who specializes in explosions and detonating dynamite. He fights by introducing chaotic, explosive elements into any environment, using plungers, dynamite sticks, and triggers with gleeful abandon.

mechanisms: Resilience typical of Muppets to slapstick destruction

weaknesses: Prone to accidentally blowing himself up with his own explosives
limitations: Relies entirely on available explosive charges

sources.supports: Character profile of Crazy Harry as the pyromaniac Muppet.

feats.claim: Blew up various props, sets, and portions of the Muppet Theater with hidden dynamite.

campaignTags.claim: Uses dynamite and explosives for combat and demolition

unknowns: Whether he possesses any formal combat training beyond random demolition.

characters.summary: Doc is a human inventor living in a workshop alongside his dog Sprocket. He engages conflicts using improvised workshop gadgets, tools, and human problem-solving skills.
weaknesses: Oblivious to the existence of Fraggles for much of the series
limitations: Fighter lacks supernatural powers or advanced combat training

sources.supports: Doc character overview as the human inventor in Fraggle Rock.

feats.claim: Invented elaborate automated contraptions to solve everyday household problems.

campaignTags.claim: Creates complex Rube Goldberg machines and mechanical contraptions
Carries and utilizes various workshop tools and devices

unknowns: Combat effectiveness against armed supernatural opponents.

characters.summary: Dr. Bunsen Honeydew is a brilliant yet dangerously absent-minded scientist heading Muppet Labs. He approaches conflicts or challenges by deploying futuristic, bizarre, and often unstable technological inventions.

mechanisms: Escape via teleportation or experimental shielding

weaknesses: Inventions frequently backfire on him or his assistant Beaker

sources.supports: Overview of Dr. Bunsen Honeydew and Muppet Labs inventions.

feats.claim: Invented edible paper clips, edible safety pins, and hand-held matter transmitters.

campaignTags.claim: Head scientist and creator of numerous advanced experimental devices
Equipped with portable lasers, shrinking devices, and gadgets

unknowns: Combat effectiveness without prep time or laboratory equipment.

characters.summary: Dr. Julius Strangepork is a sophisticated, scientifically minded pig serving as the resident scientist aboard the Pigs in Space segment. He utilizes futuristic space-age ray guns, laser technology, and sci-fi gadgets.
weaknesses: Pompous attitude makes him susceptible to ambushes
limitations: Dependent on starship life support and equipment
Prone to panic under extreme cosmic pressure

sources.supports: Details on Dr. Julius Strangepork's role in Pigs in Space.

feats.claim: Operated advanced sci-fi console controls and repelled alien boarding parties using ray weapons.
feats.citation: The Muppet Show (Pigs in Space segments)

campaignTags.claim: Operates advanced interstellar spacecraft and ray technology
Crew member and co-pilot of the Swinetrek starship

unknowns: Hand-to-hand combat capability outside of a sci-fi bridge setting.

characters.summary: Dr. Teeth is the flamboyant, gold-toothed keyboardist and leader of the Electric Mayhem. While primarily a musician, he possesses charismatic leadership, sonic projection via his music, and surprising physical dexterity.
weaknesses: Easily distracted by jam sessions and musical rhythms
limitations: Relies on his bandmates for group engagements

sources.supports: Profile of Dr. Teeth as leader of the Electric Mayhem.

feats.claim: Performed intense, high-energy musical sets that rattled the entire Muppet Theater structure.

unknowns: Actual combat record against trained combatants.

characters.summary: Elmo is an energetic, optimistic red monster from Sesame Street. He fights using relentless enthusiasm, high-speed scurrying, tickle attacks, and surprisingly resilient monster durability.
weaknesses: Childlike naivety makes him vulnerable to manipulation
limitations: Lacks lethal force or destructive weapon capabilities

sources.supports: Elmo character history and traits on Sesame Street.

feats.claim: Evaded capture and out-maneuvered adults through rapid scuttling and hiding.

characters.summary: Emmet Otter is a humble, resourceful woodland river otter who relies on folksy ingenuity, washing tubs, and musical instruments. He is an acoustic musician and resourceful provider rather than a combatant.
weaknesses: Poverty-stricken and lacks defensive armor or weaponry
limitations: Completely lacking in combat training or aggressive instincts

sources.supports: Plot and character details for Emmet Otter.

feats.claim: Swam across fast-moving rivers and built functional makeshift musical instruments out of household scraps.

campaignTags.claim: Natural river otter capable of aquatic swimming and diving
Aquatic mammal adapted to river environments

unknowns: Combat capabilities outside of peaceful musical contexts.
